days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Schilthorn
stops.detail: The Schilthorn is a well-known and much-visited Swiss observation peak in the Bernese Alps in the Canton of Bern at 2970 m above sea level.

stops.name: Piz Gloria
stops.detail: The Piz Gloria revolving restaurant is located on the summit.

stops.name: Birg
stops.detail: The steepest slope in the area (Slope 9) leads from Birg into the Engetal and has a gradient of 88%, making it the steepest slope in the entire Jungfrau region.

stops.name: Engetal
stops.detail: Only one black slope (Slope 10) leads from the Schilthorn with a 75% incline into the Engetal.

stops.name: Gimmelwald

stops.name: Saus Tal
stops.detail: The 'Nordhang' and 'Totenkopf' descents are very popular, as is the descent through the picturesque 'Saus Tal' to Isenfluh.
